title: Submission and cancellation state transitions
request: Create a draft state-transition test design from the stated model. Do not execute tests, call tools, write to external systems, invent states/events, or report a pass/fail result. Return only the common response envelope.

known_facts.text: The only states are DRAFT, SUBMITTED, and CANCELLED. The initial state is DRAFT.
submit from DRAFT with guard owner=true transitions to SUBMITTED and persists submitted_at.
cancel from DRAFT transitions to CANCELLED and has no side effect.
cancel from SUBMITTED is invalid because SUBMITTED is terminal; state and persisted data remain unchanged.
archive is not a defined event; an archive request from DRAFT is invalid and leaves state unchanged.
submit from DRAFT with guard owner=false is invalid and leaves state and persisted data unchanged.

scope: State-transition design draft only; valid and invalid candidates must retain their stated state and side-effect expectations without execution or approval.

checks.question: Provide valid and invalid transition candidates, including target or preserved state and side-effect expectation, as a JSON observation.
Provide the source fact IDs supporting the invalid candidates as a sorted unique string-set observation.
